notes: Replies that ignored the length you set, and a chat that looks like one. Setting a length only said so once, near the top of a system prompt that a long conversation then buries — and a model copies the length of the messages it can see far more readily than it obeys a sentence from a thousand tokens ago, so a thread that had been sprawling carried on sprawling. The length is now restated as the last thing before every reply, with the history named as something not to imitate. Bubbles have a tail at the corner nearest whoever sent them, sender pictures sit at the top of a message rather than the bottom, and in dark mode the incoming bubble is no longer a shade away from the wallpaper behind it — it now stands off the background about twenty times more clearly.
